say:2:1910824001:1.text: I've brought a gift. A special gem.
say:2:1910824001:1.source_cn: 我带来了礼物，一枚特殊的宝石。

say:3:1910824002:1.text: It's a thing of the land, not grown in the sea or polished by any tide. The people of the land say that inside every gem lies a different piece of the sky.
say:3:1910824002:1.source_cn: 它是陆地的造物，不在海中生长，不被潮汐打磨。陆地上的人...

say:4:1910824003:1.text: And the one I've brought was born in a place where the wind passes through. There, the sun and the moon, over the course of a day, shine from different angles and condense into different colors.
say:4:1910824003:1.source_cn: 而我带来的这一枚，它诞生于某个有风穿过的地方。在那里，...

say:5:1910824004:1.text: It's a gem that changes color with the light, Oceana. It suits you.
say:5:1910824004:1.source_cn: 这是一枚会随光线改变颜色的宝石，奥汐娜，它很适合你。

say:6:1910824005:1.text: The mortals on the land are praying to the Shimmering Sea through the night. They sing your praises aloud and are convinced that the tsunami changed course at the last moment. A miracle, they call it.
say:6:1910824005:1.source_cn: 陆地上的凡人正在对流光海彻夜祈祷，他们高声称颂，认定海...

say:7:1910824006:1.text: Oh, dear mortals. They've got the wrong goddess. It was my awakening that caused the tsunami. It was you who protected them.
say:7:1910824006:1.source_cn: 哦，可爱的陆地人，他们认错了人。明明是我的复苏造成了海...

say:8:1910824007:1.text: That came from your wish. You erased the Merfolk and, at the same time, sent me to save the mortals of the land.
say:8:1910824007:1.source_cn: 那来自于你的愿望。奥汐娜，你抹杀了海裔，与此同时，却让...

say:9:1910824008:1.text: I have been thinking about what you said... "Even gods can change."
say:9:1910824008:1.source_cn: 我一直在想你说过的话——“就连神明也可以发生变化”。

say:10:1910824009:1.text: Before I came here, I went west. There I saw a glorious sunset.
say:10:1910824009:1.source_cn: 此次到访前，我曾前往西方，在彼处目睹到壮烈的日落。

say:11:1910824010:1.text: Rai'Sokal died. He died for mortals. No one prayed to him, yet he gave up his blood of his own will and dyed the desert red.
say:11:1910824010:1.source_cn: 瑞·索卡尔死了，他为凡人而死。无人向他祈求，他却自愿献...

say:12:1910824011:1.text: Tell me, Oceana. Can a wretched soul within a god's body also change?
say:12:1910824011:1.source_cn: 告诉我，奥汐娜……神躯中的可悲灵魂，也能发生改变吗？

say:13:1910824012:1.text: I know what you wish to ask. It is not only I who can change. You can change too, my dear sister.
say:13:1910824012:1.source_cn: 我知道你想问什么。不止是我，你也可以改变，我亲爱的妹妹。

say:14:1910824013:1.text: You have not yet taken my soul in the name of these mortals. In the past ten thousand years, you've shown almost no mercy to your own kind. Is that not a kind of change?
say:14:1910824013:1.source_cn: 你还没有以凡人的名义夺走我的灵魂，在过去的万年里，你几...

say:15:1910824014:1.text: Perhaps... Rai'Sokal taught me that gods and mortals are not wholly opposed... but he did it with his life.
say:15:1910824014:1.source_cn: 或许吧，瑞·索卡尔用生命告诉我，神明与凡人并非完全对立...

say:16:1910824015:1.text: This time, I mean to try a different way to make you understand the world as I see it. It will be long and painful... It might even be called a mistake.
say:16:1910824015:1.source_cn: 这次，我准备换一种方式让你理解我所认知的世界。它会很漫...

say:17:1910824016:1.text: But my hands are already stained with so much blood. What's one more sin...?
say:17:1910824016:1.source_cn: 不过，我的手上已经鲜血累累，再多一份罪孽又如何呢……

say:18:1910824017:1.text: I will not be your enemy, Oceana. I'll help your fragments. One day, you will understand their pain and understand their existence... even if it takes thousands of years.
say:18:1910824017:1.source_cn: 我不会与你为敌，奥汐娜，我会帮助你的碎片。总有一天，你...

say:19:1910824018:1.text: I hope that when that day comes, you will make a different choice. Only then can mortals and gods truly live side by side.
say:19:1910824018:1.source_cn: 希望到时候，你会做出不同的选择。到那时，凡人与神明才能...

say:20:1910824019:1.text: My word, you truly are changing! Rest easy. As long as it stops you from slaughtering our kind, I'll wait for you for however many years it takes.
say:20:1910824019:1.source_cn: 你的确有在改变！放心吧，只要能够阻止你对同族的杀戮，无...

say:21:1910824020:1.text: The gods fell, one after another. Our laments pierced the sky. In the eyes of mortals, you're the goddess of life who shelters all living things. But in the eyes of the gods, you are something else entirely...
say:21:1910824020:1.source_cn: 神明相继陨落，哀嚎贯穿天际，在凡人眼中，你是庇佑众生的...

say:22:1910824021:1.text: And what do you take me for? The god of death for gods? A god of war?
say:22:1910824021:1.source_cn: 你们认为我是什么？神明的死神吗，或是战争之神？

say:23:1910824022:1.text: Hmm... what are you? I don't know. When I look at you, all I see is my dear little sister. Perhaps it's because we're so much alike.
say:23:1910824022:1.source_cn: 嗯……是什么呢？我不知道。看着你的时候，我只能望到亲爱...

say:24:1910824023:1.text: How akin our powers are. I have brought forth countless creatures of the sea. You, too, should bring not death, but life.
say:24:1910824023:1.source_cn: 我们的权能多么相近啊，我创造出了万千海裔，你该带来的也...

say:26:1910824025:1.text: Mortals cling to the Tree of Life. The gods are its branches, and mortals are its leaves. When the branches wither, what withers next?
say:26:1910824025:1.source_cn: 凡人依附于生命树，神明是枝干，凡人为树叶，枝干凋零之后...

say:27:1910824026:1.text: Unlimited blood soaked the earth, and beneath the tree a mountain of corpses has piled up. All the seawater in the world could not wash my hands clean. I wished to create life, but what was born was only flesh that could neither live nor die.
say:27:1910824026:1.source_cn: 想到这点，才发觉无数鲜血浸透大地，树下也已积累如山的尸...

say:28:1910824027:1.text: I too am a branch of the Tree of Life, and I have committed a monstrous crime against my own kind. No... new life cannot come from me!
say:28:1910824027:1.source_cn: 我也是生命树上的一枝，且对同族犯下了滔天罪行——不，新...

say:29:1910824028:1.text: It must <style="highlight">transcend the Tree of Life</style>. It must be made wholly pure, an untainted life, if it is to avoid repeating our mistakes.

say:30:1910824029:1.text: So I too have a request. Help me, Oceana. Of all the gods, only you can help me exercise my power.
say:30:1910824029:1.source_cn: 所以我也有一事相求：请帮助我，奥汐娜，诸神中，只有你能...

say:31:1910824030:1.text: <style="highlight">Goddess of the Sea and Birth</style>, my sister... I beg your aid.

narration:33:1910824031:1.text: The two figures turn to sea mist...
narration:33:1910824031:1.male: The two figures turn to sea mist...
narration:33:1910824031:1.female: The two figures turn to sea mist...

narration:34:1910824032:1.text: ...and drift away into a deeper blue sea.
narration:34:1910824032:1.male: ...and drift away into a deeper blue sea.
narration:34:1910824032:1.female: ...and drift away into a deeper blue sea.

say:35:1910824033:1.text: 信息。无数信息。回忆的海啸将你吞噬，艾雅与奥汐娜达成了某种协议，她想创造生命……？
say:35:1910824033:1.source_cn: 信息。无数信息。回忆的海啸将你吞噬，艾雅与奥汐娜达成了...

say:36:1910824034:1.text: Light flickers before your eyes. In that unknown corner, humanoid shapes of flesh reach out their hands to you. They overflow with divine and living power, and yet they are filled with jealousy and hatred.
say:36:1910824034:1.source_cn: 眼前光芒闪动，在那个未知的角落，拟人的血肉造物向你伸出...
say:36:1910824034:1.male: Light flickers before your eyes. In that unknown corner, humanoid shapes of flesh reach out their hands to you. They overflow with divine and living power, and yet they are filled with jealousy and hatred.
say:36:1910824034:1.female: Light flickers before your eyes. In that unknown corner, humanoid shapes of flesh reach out their hands to you. They overflow with divine and living power, and yet they are filled with jealousy and hatred.

say:37:1910824035:1.text: 它们未生，未活，未死，一张张没能长出出双眼的面孔死死盯着你……
say:37:1910824035:1.source_cn: 它们未生，未活，未死，一张张没能长出出双眼的面孔死死盯...

say:38:1910824036:1.text: And then, at last, an ancient voice hums in your ear.
say:38:1910824036:1.source_cn: 最后，一个远古的声音在你耳畔嗡嗡作响。
say:38:1910824036:1.male: And then, at last, an ancient voice hums in your ear.
say:38:1910824036:1.female: And then, at last, an ancient voice hums in your ear.

say:42:1910824039:1.text: What were those two going on about? Tsunami this, creating Merfolk that?! What does that even mean? I don't get it.
say:42:1910824039:1.source_cn: 那俩人在说什么海啸，什么创造海裔？！她们在说啥？！咱听不懂！
say:42:1910824039:1.male: What were those two going on about? Tsunami this, creating Merfolk that?! What does that even mean? I don't get it.
say:42:1910824039:1.female: What were those two going on about? Tsunami this, creating Merfolk that?! What does that even mean? I don't get it.

say:44:1910824040:1.text: What? So you're saying that Elphira, the tentacle guy, Grandma, all of Coralia, and the Deepfolk too... they were all born from that dark-haired lady? They're her children?
say:44:1910824040:1.source_cn: 什么？你是说艾菲拉和触手男，阿嬷，整个塔拉萨，还有深海...
say:44:1910824040:1.male: What? So you're saying that Elphira, the tentacle guy, Grandma, all of Coralia, and the Deepfolk too... they were all born from that dark-haired lady? They're her children?
say:44:1910824040:1.female: What? So you're saying that Elphira, the tentacle guy, Grandma, all of Coralia, and the Deepfolk too... they were all born from that dark-haired lady? They're her children?

say:45:1910824041:1.text: What kind of bullcrap is that?! That crazy witch destroyed the Merfolk, and she didn't even blink! What kind of mother does that?
say:45:1910824041:1.source_cn: 你在说什么疯话！？那个疯子毁灭了海裔，而且她心安理得—...
say:45:1910824041:1.male: What kind of bullcrap is that?! That crazy witch destroyed the Merfolk, and she didn't even blink! What kind of mother does that?

choice:43:0:1.text: Merfolk were created by the Goddess of the Sea and Birth.
choice:43:0:1.source_cn: 所有海裔都是洋流与繁育之神的造物
choice:43:0:1.male: Merfolk were created by the Goddess of the Sea and Birth.
choice:43:0:1.female: Merfolk were created by the Goddess of the Sea and Birth.

say:46:1910824042:1.text: A tsunami?! Th-then what about Kaflan? It's right on the coast! What about my old man and everyone else?!
say:46:1910824042:1.source_cn: 海啸？！那、那卡什澜会怎么样？卡什澜就在海岸边上，老头...
say:46:1910824042:1.male: A tsunami?! Th-then what about Kaflan? It's right on the coast! What about my old man and everyone else?!
say:46:1910824042:1.female: A tsunami?! Th-then what about Kaflan? It's right on the coast! What about my old man and everyone else?!

choice:43:1:2.text: The awakening of this goddess will cause a tsunami.
choice:43:1:2.source_cn: 洋流与繁育之神的复苏……会引发海啸
choice:43:1:2.male: The awakening of this goddess will cause a tsunami.
choice:43:1:2.female: The awakening of this goddess will cause a tsunami.

say:47:1910824043:1.text: She's the Dura you came looking for, isn't she?
say:47:1910824043:1.source_cn: 那个艾雅就是你这次来找的人，是不？
say:47:1910824043:1.male: She's the Dura you came looking for, isn't she?
say:47:1910824043:1.female: She's the Dura you came looking for, isn't she?

say:48:1910824044:1.text: But she didn't show up. Pah! All that talk about saving the people on the coast! It was a lie!
say:48:1910824044:1.source_cn: 但她没来，呸！她说要拯救陆地的人，都是谎话！
say:48:1910824044:1.male: But she didn't show up. Pah! All that talk about saving the people on the coast! It was a lie!
say:48:1910824044:1.female: But she didn't show up. Pah! All that talk about saving the people on the coast! It was a lie!

choice:43:2:3.text: Dura was supposed to come. But this time...
choice:43:2:3.source_cn: 艾雅本该来的，但是这次……
choice:43:2:3.male: Dura was supposed to come. But this time...
choice:43:2:3.female: Dura was supposed to come. But this time...

say:49:1910824045:1.text: What are you talking about? I don't follow.
say:49:1910824045:1.male: What are you talking about? I don't follow.
say:49:1910824045:1.female: What are you talking about? I don't follow.

say:50:1910824046:1.text: Look, you gotta pull yourself together! We don't have to be scared of that sea goddess. She's tough, sure, but her power doesn't work on us.
say:50:1910824046:1.source_cn: 老大，振作起来……咱们不怕那个洋流神。她虽然厉害得很，...
say:50:1910824046:1.male: Look, you gotta pull yourself together! We don't have to be scared of that sea goddess. She's tough, sure, but her power doesn't work on us.
say:50:1910824046:1.female: Look, you gotta pull yourself together! We don't have to be scared of that sea goddess. She's tough, sure, but her power doesn't work on us.

say:51:1910824047:1.text: We're the only ones that can save everyone. We can't let that tsunami happen! I won't let her swallow up Kaflan!
say:51:1910824047:1.source_cn: 咱们，只有咱们能拯救大家。咱……咱绝不允许海啸发生，绝...
say:51:1910824047:1.male: We're the only ones that can save everyone. We can't let that tsunami happen! I won't let her swallow up Kaflan!
say:51:1910824047:1.female: We're the only ones that can save everyone. We can't let that tsunami happen! I won't let her swallow up Kaflan!

say:52:1910824048:1.text: What Dura couldn't pull off, we can! Right, boss man?
say:52:1910824048:1.source_cn: 那个叫艾雅的人没办到的事，咱们可以办到！对不，老大？！
say:52:1910824048:1.male: What Dura couldn't pull off, we can! Right, boss man?
say:52:1910824048:1.female: What Dura couldn't pull off, we can! Right, boss lady?

say:53:1910824049:1.text: You cannot be certain. You need the power of a god. Yet all that remains here are Oceana and her fragments.
say:53:1910824049:1.source_cn: 你无法确定。你需要神的力量，然而，这里只有奥汐娜，以及...
say:53:1910824049:1.male: You cannot be certain. You need the power of a god. Yet all that remains here are Oceana and her fragments.
say:53:1910824049:1.female: You cannot be certain. You need the power of a god. Yet all that remains here are Oceana and her fragments.

say:54:1910824050:1.text: You try to believe that your friends have not completely faded away. You have to take a leap of faith. This is the only way... the fragments need to rise up against the goddess herself.
say:54:1910824050:1.source_cn: 你必须相信朋友们的意识还没有完全消失。你必须放手一搏，...
say:54:1910824050:1.male: You try to believe that your friends have not completely faded away. You have to take a leap of faith. This is the only way... the fragments need to rise up against the goddess herself.
say:54:1910824050:1.female: You try to believe that your friends have not completely faded away. You have to take a leap of faith. This is the only way... the fragments need to rise up against the goddess herself.

say:55:1910824051:1.text: 你需要说服自己相信，然后说服自己支撑着前进，因为如果不说服自己，你就会开始质疑自身的存在。
say:55:1910824051:1.source_cn: 你需要说服自己相信，然后说服自己支撑着前进，因为如果不...

say:56:1910824052:1.text: 你可能也是某人的造物，如果不说服自己，你所认定的“使命”，你一直以来所坚信的东西，也将如水中月，镜中花般变得缥缈不清……

say:58:1910824053:1.text: To feel your own existence, you dig your nails deep into your palms and nearly draw blood...
say:58:1910824053:1.source_cn: 为了感受自己的存在，你的指甲深深陷入自己的手掌，几乎能...

say:58:1910824053:1.female: To feel your own existence, you dig your nails deep into your palms and nearly draw blood...

say:59:1910824055:1.source_cn: 这很难，但你支撑着站直了身体。
say:59:1910824055:1.male: It's not easy, but you force yourself to stand.

choice_prompt:60:1910824055.female: It's not easy, but you force yourself to stand.

say:62:1910824057:1.text: I'm all set! Let's sink those annoying pests!
say:62:1910824057:1.source_cn: 咱准备好了，一起把周围那些烦人的家伙击沉吧！
say:62:1910824057:1.male: I'm all set! Let's sink those annoying pests!

choice:60:1:2.source_cn: 当然，我们还有一整个城市要拯救
choice:60:1:2.male: Of course, we still have a whole city to save.
choice:60:1:2.female: Of course, we still have a whole city to save.

say:64:1910824054:1.source_cn: 它在跳动，如常人一般跳动。
say:64:1910824054:1.male: My heart beats. It beats like any other person's.
